verdict.rationale: Motion's own docs claim several in-product, data-driven AI signals. It analyzes your work to highlight your #1 priority, warns about at-risk tasks and off-track projects, flags overcapacity, and predicts project finish dates from team capacity. All of these are vendor marketing claims with no hands-on or independent corroboration, and they are narrow scheduling and risk signals rather than open-ended insights or suggestions about your data. missing for 10: general-purpose AI insights or analysis over user data (e.g., ask-your-data or AI-generated reports), detailed documentation of how the suggestions are produced and surfaced, independent or hands-on corroboration that the insights work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Motion analyzes all your work and highlights your #1 priority at any moment
When Motion thinks a task is at-risk of missing deadline, it proactively warns you days, weeks, or months in advance.
we can predict exactly when a project will finish based on your team's capacity, and all the other ongoing projects.
Motion schedules tasks based on your actual capacity and flags when you've scheduled more than you can handle
As soon as a project is off-track, Motion alerts you so that you can course-correct before it's too late.
